iOS Engineer
Tidewave ApS · Copenhagen (hybrid) or remote in EU

What you'll be doing
- Building new features for our sailing navigation app in Swift and SwiftUI
- Improving performance and offline support
- Reviewing code and shaping our mobile architecture

What we're looking for
- 3+ years building native iOS apps with Swift
- Production experience with SwiftUI
- Good understanding of Xcode, Instruments and Git
- Experience with Kotlin (we also ship Android) is a plus
- Familiarity with Combine and App Store release processes is a bonus

What we offer
- Equity, 6 weeks vacation, pension
- Free lunch in the office, visa support for non-EU candidates
- 24 weeks paid parental leave

Tidewave is committed to diversity and inclusion.
Write to Mads at jobs@tidewave.example
